messages.content: Answer the listed CURRENT travel preference fields from the supplied USER dialogue. Respect domains, changes, exceptions and explicit references. Assistant suggestions alone are not user decisions. Return JSON {"answers":{"hotel.area":"centre"}} keyed by every requested field; use UNKNOWN when unsupported. Normalize area centre/north/south/east/west; price cheap/moderate/expensive; stars digits; lodging type hotel/guesthouse; cuisine and attraction type lower-case. No confidence scores.

0 USER: I'm looking for a restaurant that serves vietnamese food on the south side of town, is there anything like that?
1 ASSISTANT: There are no Vietnamese restaurants on the south side but there is one on the west side. Would that suffice?
2 USER: What about on the east side? I would like for it to be expensive.
3 ASSISTANT: I'm sorry but there are not any Vietnamese restaurants on the East side of town, either.
4 USER: Bummer, how about Indian food on the east side? I'm willing to pay for an expensive meal, if it's good!
5 ASSISTANT: There are 4 Indian restaurant on the East side ranging from moderately priced to expensive. Do you have a price preference?
6 USER: Expensive would be fine. Can I have the address for the most expensive Indian restaurant out of the four? 
7 ASSISTANT: How about the Pipasha Restaurant? It is in the expensive price range and serves Indian food. Their address is Newmarket Road Fen Ditton.
8 USER: I would also like to check on museums on the east side. Can you see what you have in that area?
9 ASSISTANT: I have found four museums.  3 of them are free and one costs 5 pounds.  Can I get you more information on any of them?
10 USER: I need information on all of them please.
11 ASSISTANT: What information would you like? The phone number, address, or postcode?
12 USER: the address please
13 ASSISTANT: I can give you the address for only one, is there one in particular you wish to learn more about?
14 USER: Give me information on the one closest to Pipasha Restaurant.
15 ASSISTANT: They are all in the same general area, but Cambridge Artworks is nice. It is located at 5 Greens Road, cb13ef. You can call them at 01223902168.
16 USER: Cool! Is that one of the free ones? Gotta save my money for the grub, you know.
17 ASSISTANT: Cambridge artworks is free.
18 USER: Perfect! Thank you so much for your help! 
19 ASSISTANT: Anything else I can do for you?
FIELDS ["attraction.area","attraction.type","restaurant.area","restaurant.food","restaurant.pricerange"]
